2706.title: Codex child-tool disable contract
2706.rootCauseOneLine: The disabled setting sends Codex feature limits, but bb neither removes the native child tool nor adds a bb delegation route.
2706.proposedFix: Use a supported native tool filter, or append a tested provider instruction that routes delegation to bb child threads.
2706.caveats: Codex CLI 0.150.1 exposed the tool and started a child. The reported limit error needs a direct check with CLI 0.151.0.
